scheme_name: Mahila Samrudhhi Yojana (Gujarat Gopalak Vikas Nigam)
description:
The Mahila Samrudhhi Yojana is a significant welfare scheme initiated by the Government of Gujarat. 

This scheme was launched in the year 2019. 

It aims to empower women by providing them with opportunities for self-employment and financial independence. 

The Mahila Samrudhhi Yojana is specifically designed for women who are involved in the dairy sector. 

The scheme is implemented by the Gujarat Gopalak Vikas Nigam. 

The primary objective of the Mahila Samrudhhi Yojana is to enhance the income of women dairy farmers. 

The scheme targets to increase the milk production capacity of women by providing them with necessary resources and training. 

One of the measurable targets includes increasing the average milk production per woman from 5 liters to 10 liters per day within a span of three years. 

The scheme also aims to provide women with access to credit facilities. 

Under this scheme, women can avail of loans up to INR 1 lakh at a subsidized interest rate of 4 percent. 

The financial assistance provided under the Mahila Samrudhhi Yojana is aimed at purchasing dairy animals, equipment, and feed. 

Women beneficiaries will receive training on best practices in dairy farming. 

The training includes aspects such as animal husbandry, veterinary care, and milk processing techniques. 

The scheme also emphasizes the importance of cooperative societies. 

Women are encouraged to form self-help groups or cooperatives to enhance their bargaining power. 

The Mahila Samrudhhi Yojana provides a platform for women to share knowledge and resources. 

Eligibility criteria for this scheme include women who are members of dairy cooperatives. 

Beneficiaries must be at least 18 years old. 

There is no upper age limit for participation in the scheme. 

The income ceiling for eligibility is set at INR 1.5 lakh per annum for rural areas. 

For urban areas, the income limit is INR 2 lakh per annum. 

Women who have prior experience in dairy farming are given preference. 

The application process for the Mahila Samrudhhi Yojana is straightforward. 

Interested women must fill out an application form available at local cooperative societies. 

Required documents include proof of identity, proof of income, and membership details of the dairy cooperative. 

Once the application is submitted, it will be reviewed by the local cooperative society. 

The review process typically takes about 15 days. 

Approved applicants will then receive a loan sanction letter. 

The disbursement of funds is done directly to the beneficiaries' bank accounts. 

The scheme has a provision for regular monitoring and evaluation. 

Beneficiaries are required to submit progress reports every six months. 

The Gujarat Gopalak Vikas Nigam conducts workshops and training sessions regularly. 

These sessions are aimed at enhancing the skills of women in dairy farming. 

The Mahila Samrudhhi Yojana also promotes the use of technology in dairy farming. 

Women are encouraged to use mobile applications for tracking their dairy production. 

The scheme has seen a positive impact on the livelihoods of women in Gujarat. 

As of 2023, over 10,000 women have benefited from the scheme. 

The average increase in income for beneficiaries has been reported at 30 percent. 

The scheme has also contributed to the overall growth of the dairy sector in Gujarat. 

Gujarat is one of the leading states in milk production in India. 

The Mahila Samrudhhi Yojana aligns with the national goal of doubling farmers' income by 2022. 

The scheme is part of the broader initiative to empower women in rural areas. 

The Gujarat government has allocated a budget of INR 50 crores for the implementation of this scheme. 

The Mahila Samrudhhi Yojana also collaborates with various NGOs for outreach and training. 

These NGOs help in identifying potential beneficiaries and providing additional support. 

The scheme encourages women to take leadership roles within their communities. 

Women who excel in dairy farming are recognized and awarded at state-level events. 

The Mahila Samrudhhi Yojana has received positive feedback from beneficiaries. 

Many women report increased confidence and improved quality of life. 

The scheme is continuously being evaluated for its effectiveness. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is taken into account for future improvements. 

The Gujarat Gopalak Vikas Nigam provides a helpline for queries related to the scheme. 

The contact number for assistance is 1800 233 3333. 

The scheme is expected to expand its reach in the coming years. 

The government aims to include more women from marginalized communities. 

The Mahila Samrudhhi Yojana is a vital step towards gender equality in agriculture. 

It not only focuses on economic empowerment but also on social empowerment. 

The scheme promotes sustainable practices in dairy farming. 

Women are educated about the importance of animal welfare and environmental sustainability. 

The Mahila Samrudhhi Yojana is a model for similar initiatives in other states. 

It showcases the potential of women in contributing to the economy. 

The success of this scheme can lead to the formulation of more targeted welfare programs. 

Overall, the Mahila Samrudhhi Yojana represents a comprehensive approach to women's empowerment in Gujarat. 

It combines financial assistance with education and community building. 

The scheme is a testament to the government's commitment to improving the lives of women in rural areas.
